verdict.rationale: Docs directly walk through creating a feature via 'Create Feature' in the dashboard, naming it, and toggling it on/off per environment without deploying code, and GitHub README emphasizes toggling flags live in production instantly. This matches core simple flag-management workflow expected within minutes of signup, though evidence lacks a hands-on/independent account of actual onboarding speed. Missing for 10: independent user account confirming sign-up-to-toggle speed, and any friction/limits noted in trial/free tier.
